sourceTitle: Memoir of the Life of John Quincy Adams.
description: "Memoir of the Life of John Quincy Adams" by Josiah Quincy is a historical account written in the mid-19th century. The book provides a comprehensive biography of John Quincy Adams, the sixth President of the United States, detailing his early life, education, extensive diplomatic career, and significant events during his presidency.
